integrity: The displayed formula was derived from an explicit structural characterization of all non-total forcing assignments, checked against direct exhaustive simulation on small bicliques, and compared with the source's small examples and its \(\lambda=2\) bipartite theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved only for complete bipartite graphs and \(\lambda\ge3\). The finite verifier covers only small profiles and is corroborative; the unrestricted parameter range rests on the symbolic proof. A poorly indexed equivalent result under different terminology remains a bibliographic residual risk.
title: Forced colouring functions of complete bipartite graphs for \(\lambda\ge3\)
